sidebar.title: Workspaces
sidebar.noWorkspacesHint: Open a project or clone from URL to start from zero.
sidebar.removeProjectDescription: This will permanently remove all workspaces in this project from DCC ({{count}}) and delete their local worktrees from disk.
sidebar.removeProjectWarning: In DCC's current model, conversations and sessions tied to those workspaces also become inaccessible from the interface. The root repository stays preserved.

commandPalette.title: Workspace command palette
commandPalette.description: Jump to a workspace or run an action.

workspaceDialog.cloneDescription: Clone a remote repository into a local folder, then create the worktree from it. Leave base branch empty to auto-detect the remote default branch.
workspaceDialog.createDescription: New worktree from a local repo path and base branch.
workspaceDialog.usingTrackedRepository: Using the repository already added to DCC: {{label}}
workspaceDialog.chooseFolderForBranches: Choose a folder to load branches
workspaceDialog.toastSetupWarning: Workspace is ready, but setup still needs attention: {{commands}}

bootstrap.title: No workspace open
bootstrap.description: Open a project or clone from URL to start from zero. The chat, inspector, and terminal surfaces will appear once a workspace exists.

remoteMode.sessionsUnavailable: Remote backend is connected, but session controls still run only against the local runtime.
remoteMode.workspaceActionsUnavailable: This workspace action is not available while a remote backend is active.

empty.title: No workspace selected
empty.description: Open or create a workspace to inspect git state and session activity.

spec.description: Versioned DCC state for this mission. Generate a plan from it when the requirements are ready.
spec.compactAutoReanchorNote: Automatic post-/compact re-anchor only fires when DCC observes an explicit `/compact` command. Provider-internal compaction still exposes no reliable signal.
spec.compiledContextChecking: Checking the manifest and provider-native targets...
spec.compiledContextCurrent: The manifest and provider-native targets match the active mission spec.
spec.compiledContextStale: The manifest or provider-native targets are missing or stale. Run Compile context before using provider-native repo context.
spec.autoCompileIssueDescription: Automatic spec compilation failed {{count}} times in a row. Prompt-based re-anchor still continued so resume stayed unblocked.
spec.criteriaCoveragePending: {{count}} acceptance criteria item(s) are still not covered by the active plan.
spec.criteriaCoverageComplete: The active plan covers every known acceptance criterion.
spec.suggestedValidationChecksDescription: The spec did not declare explicit checks. These defaults come from the spec's own validation profiles.

resumeState.needs_validation: No saved validation yet. Re-anchor will ask the agent to confirm every acceptance criterion.
resumeState.stale_validation: Saved validation is stale or missing a spec hash. Re-anchor will treat it as historical context.
resumeState.pending: Next unresolved acceptance criteria from the saved validation.
resumeState.complete: Saved validation marks all known acceptance criteria as passing.

spec.inlinePreviewHint: Long mission specs stay easier to inspect in the center panel without stretching the inspector layout.
spec.surfaceHint: Read-only mission spec view. Press Escape to return to the conversation surface.
spec.emptyDescription: Run /spec in the composer to create .devcommandcenter/specs/<branch>.spec.md.

plan.emptyDescription: When the assistant generates a plan, it will stay visible here while the session continues.

inspector.sessionFallback: No active session - start one from the composer.
inspector.terminalNote: Terminal sessions stay in the workbench drawer at the bottom of the layout - they are not mirrored here so the inspector stays focused on Git and session signals.

conversationLaunch.hint: Start from scratch with a blank thread. Use one of the prompts below or launch the session first and build from there.
conversationLaunch.footerHint: The conversation will appear here once you send the first prompt.

prompts.summarize: Summarize what this workspace already contains.
prompts.entryPoints: Find the main entry points in this repo.
prompts.nextAction: Show me the next best action to continue from zero.

placeholder.default: Ask for changes, @mention files, and run /commands
placeholder.plan: Describe what to change, then click Request Changes

settings.title: Settings
settings.currentWorkspaceHint: Repository-scoped preferences live with the active workspace.
settings.languageHint: Brazilian Portuguese by default; English available for international teams.

connections.label: Connections
connections.description: Phones and tablets paired with this desktop.

shortcuts.label: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Active shortcuts and the cheatsheet are available.

general.shellBehaviorBody: The desktop shell opens with the workspace, composer, and inspector aligned in the main flow.
general.defaultEntryBody: Workspaces open into the inspector-first workbench with the composer in the center pane.
general.commandPaletteBody: The command palette opens workspace switching and actions.

appearance.themeHint: Match the shell to the system or force a fixed mode.
appearance.colorSystemHint: The color system is driven by shell tokens, so this choice changes the whole chrome instead of just the canvas.

model.providersHint: Choose the default runtime for new sessions and composer sends.
model.runtimeHint: Codex, Claude, and Gemini use isolated homes here. Cursor stays untouched.
model.runtimeCardBody: Isolated home directories keep the provider runtime independent from the user shell.
model.runtimeNoSupportedProviders: No supported providers are available in the current catalog.

shortcuts.keyboardShortcutsHint: The most-used shortcuts are already wired into this interface.
shortcuts.comingSoonBody: The shortcuts already work, but customization for this section has not been implemented yet.

git.chromeHint: The branch bar and commit action live in the inspector.
git.comingSoonBody: The interface already shows the Git flow, but editable preferences have not been implemented yet.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.body: No preview toggles are exposed yet. This section stays ready for future options.
experimental.comingSoonBody: No preview toggles are exposed yet. When test flags exist, they will live here.

account.title: Forge accounts
account.hint: Manage local authentication with GitHub CLI and GitLab CLI without leaving the app.
account.cardHint: Open an embedded terminal to authenticate with `gh auth login` or `glab auth login` inside DCC.
account.githubHint: Use `github.com` or your GitHub Enterprise hostname.
account.gitlabHint: Use `gitlab.com` or your self-hosted GitLab hostname.
account.repoNotBound: No {{provider}} account is bound to this repository yet.
account.repoBindingExpired: The @{{login}} account bound to this repository is no longer authenticated in the {{provider}} CLI.

intro.title: Welcome to Dev Command Center
intro.body: Start from the shell, keep your workspace visible, and let the thread stay in the center.

workflows.title: Choose the right way to start
workflows.body: In DCC you can send a direct prompt, ask for a plan before acting, or enter the Spec-Driven Development flow.

slashCommands.title: Type / to open local actions
slashCommands.body: Slash commands shorten the path to action without relying on memory or long prompts.

agents.title: Agents stay in the loop
agents.body: The inspector and composer are already primed for provider-driven sessions and runtime context.

repoImport.title: Import a repository
repoImport.body: Point the shell at a local repo or clone from URL and the workspace opens around it.

completeTransition.title: Ready to transition
completeTransition.body: Finish onboarding and drop into the same main interface without a context switch.

workspace.title: Workspace stays visible
workspace.body: DCC organizes the conversation around the active branch and worktree instead of a detached chat tab.

thread.title: Thread stays central
thread.body: The composer, thread viewport, and inspector behave like one execution surface.

quickChat.title: Direct prompt
quickChat.body: Use it when you already know what to ask and do not need to formalize requirements first.

planMode.title: Plan mode
planMode.body: Turn it on when you want the agent to inspect first and return a plan before editing or executing.

sdd.title: SDD flow
sdd.body: Use it when the mission needs traceable requirements, explicit validation, and spec-driven resume.

sddFlow.spec: /spec creates or updates the mission spec
sddFlow.plan: Generate plan derives the plan from the spec
sddFlow.validate: Validate audits the worktree against the criteria
sddFlow.continue: Continue next resumes the next pending criterion

workflows.sddNote: Important: `/spec` is the entry point into the SDD flow, but it does not automatically execute every later phase on its own.

slashCommands.title: Composer slash commands
slashCommands.body: When you type `/`, DCC offers local actions to enrich context, compact history, and start specific flows like SDD.

items.add-dir: Attach extra directories as conversation context.
items.compact: Request a compaction pass for the current thread context.
items.spec: Writes the starter prompt used to create or update the mission spec.
items.context: Shows the current context budget and usage.
items.commit: Prepares a commit message from the current state.

activity.title: Session activity
activity.body: The Activity tab shows thread events and progress without hiding the workspace.

spec.title: Spec in the inspector
spec.body: The Spec tab centralizes criteria, saved validation, re-anchor, and continue next when the mission uses SDD.

plan.title: Reviewable plan
plan.body: The Plan tab keeps the active plan visible and connects steps back to criteria declared in the spec.

openLocal.title: Open a local project
openLocal.body: Point DCC at an existing repository and it builds the workspace around it.

cloneRemote.title: Clone from URL
cloneRemote.body: When the repo is not on disk yet, the clone flow creates the base for workspaces and sessions.

onboarding.phase4Body: You have already seen how to open a repository, start with a direct prompt, use Plan mode, enter the SDD lane, and discover actions from `/`.
onboarding.repoCliBody: Open the terminal and run `gh auth login` so DCC can create PRs and keep GitHub actions local.
onboarding.repoCliOpened: Terminal opened. Run `gh auth login` to connect.
onboarding.conductorPreviewBody: The optional integration pass stays separate for now, but the visual flow is already available.

sessionEventFeed.emptyTimeline: No messages yet. Start a session and send something. Session events appear in this timeline.
sessionEventFeed.emptyForSession: No recent activity for this session. Switch to "All" to see events from other sessions.

workbench.resumeTooltipNone: Start or select a session first
workbench.abortTooltipNone: Start or select a session first
workbench.closeSessionConfirmEmptyDescription: "{{title}}" has no messages yet. It will be removed permanently.
workbench.closeSessionConfirmArchivedDescription: "{{title}}" will be removed from the tab bar and kept in history.
workbench.closeSessionConfirmRunningDescription: This chat is still running. Closing it will stop the current run first.

sessionSearch.title: Past sessions
sessionSearch.description: Search across previous conversations and reopen any thread.
sessionSearch.searchingDescription: Full-text search over thread titles and persisted session content.

workbench.openInEditorTooltip: Open the workspace folder in the selected editor

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Write once in a neutral source; DCC compiles to each agent. Source:
skills.selectProject: Select a project to manage its skills.
skills.targetsHint: Claude gets a faithful copy (progressive disclosure). AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md are always-on instruction; Cursor writes one rule per skill — keep few skills enabled in always-on targets.

disableInvocation.title: Disable model invocation
disableInvocation.body: Hide from the model's auto-catalog (excluded from AGENTS.md). Still available as a slash command.

skills.emptyList: No skills yet. Create one — it will be compiled for the agents you pick.
skills.compileNote: Compiles into the active worktree so the running agent sees changes.

toast.nameInvalid: Name must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. review-pr).
toast.descriptionRequired: A description is required — it is what the model sees in the catalog.
toast.pickTarget: Pick at least one target agent.
